items.title: Argon2id key wrapping
items.description: Your PIN or password now derives a key-wrapping key with Argon2id that encrypts the vault master key — the credential actually protects the vault, not just the lock screen.

items.title: Stronger key derivation
items.description: Default PBKDF2 iterations raised to 600,000 and AES-256-GCM is now the default cipher for new media.

items.title: Hardened credential checks
items.description: Constant-time comparison for all credential and decoy verification, 6-digit minimum decoy PIN, and plaintext wiped from temp files after re-encryption.

items.title: Passwords in the gallery
items.description: Open and create password entries directly from the gallery screen's quick actions.

items.title: Crypto modules split
items.description: Encryption internals split into independently tested GCM, CTR, key-derivation, header, and key-wrap modules — 33 new round-trip and auth-failure tests.

items.title: Dead code purge
items.description: Removed unused widgets, a dead asset, vestigial Firebase wiring, and stale platform stubs for a leaner build.

items.title: CI + ProGuard
items.description: GitHub Actions CI runs analyze and tests on every push; release builds now ship obfuscated with ProGuard rules for crypto and autofill.

items.title: Encrypted notes
items.description: Create, edit, and organise secure notes inside the vault with folders, search, and multi-select.

items.title: Note folders
items.description: Hierarchical folder organisation with full CRUD operations for your notes.

items.title: Voice recording
items.description: Record audio directly into the vault with real-time amplitude visualisation and preview.

items.title: Adaptive logo
items.description: Logo automatically switches between light and dark variants to match your theme.

items.title: Resizable sidebar
items.description: Drag to resize the vault explorer sidebar to your preferred width.

items.title: Centralised file service
items.description: All vault file opening now routed through a single service for better reliability.

items.title: Always up-to-date
items.description: What's New and Changelog now fetch live from GitHub — no APK update needed for release notes.

items.title: AES-256-GCM v2
items.description: Authenticated encryption with an isolate-based crypto worker pool — heavy work runs off the UI thread.

items.title: Dynamic KDF iterations
items.description: Password and PIN hashing now uses per-credential PBKDF2 iteration counts that rotate automatically when vault settings change.

items.title: Re-encryption safeguards
items.description: Detailed risk explanations are surfaced before any re-encryption begins.

items.title: Hold-to-action
items.description: Long-press a file to open an action sheet instead of immediately entering selection mode.

items.title: Multi-select action sheet
items.description: Batch operations are now organised into a clean quick-action grid.

items.title: In-app updates
items.description: Latch now checks the Play Store on launch and offers to update without leaving the app.

items.title: Sturdier exports
items.description: Parallel file export with improved progress tracking, plus fixes for vault entry parsing and empty index saves.
